en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the AV room.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?
Watch an action movie
Watch a comedy movie
Watch a science fiction movie
W-Wow!
This person spin and leap real far...
Gonta only see forest family do that!
Maybe this person related to them!

<CLT=cltMIND>Ah, I believe that's done with
wires and a stuntman...

<CLT=cltMIND>But I shouldn't say anything.
I don't want to break his heart...
Is wonderful to make others smile.

When others smile, they get warm,
fuzzy feeling.

Gonta will study hard!
Make all kinds of people smile!
Gonta no good at complicated stories.

Too hard for Gonta to understand, 
and then...Gonta fall asleep...
Is rude to movie-makers, huh?

<CLT=cltMIND>Gonta is completely silent.
That's pretty rare...
(Hmmm...)
<CLT=cltMIND>Huh?
<CLT=cltMIND>That voice just now. Is that...?
<CLT=cltMIND>Is that Gonta's inner thoughts...?
